title: Where did the allowance go?
detail: Why I built Codex Usage Meter
voice: Lately, our Codex allowance has been disappearing fast. On our two-hundred-dollar monthly subscription, we've sometimes used a week's allowance in a day. But the remaining percentage doesn't tell us which conversations used the most.
captions: Lately, our Codex allowance has been disappearing fast.
On our two-hundred-dollar monthly subscription, we've sometimes used a week's allowance in a day.
But the remaining percentage doesn't tell us which conversations used the most.

title: See usage by conversation.
detail: Input / output · Cache share · Model details
voice: So I built this plugin to show usage for each conversation. Input, output, and the input cache share are visible without expanding anything. Cache shows the percentage of input tokens read from cache. Expand the row for usage and cache share by model.
captions: So I built this plugin to show usage for each conversation.
Input, output, and the input cache share are visible without expanding anything.
Cache shows the percentage of input tokens read from cache.
Expand the row for usage and cache share by model.

title: Small enough to stay out of the way.
detail: A quick glance, without interrupting work
voice: I wanted it easy to glance at without getting in the way. The window stays small, tucked into a corner. When you don't need it, hide it in the menu bar or system tray.
captions: I wanted it easy to glance at without getting in the way.
The window stays small, tucked into a corner.

title: Know what is left—and when it resets.
detail: Weekly allowance · Manual resets · Credit expiry
voice: Weekly allowance, the next automatic reset, and available manual resets are all visible. You can also see when your next reset credit expires. That expiry is not an automatic refill. It helps you plan your usage at a glance.

title: Keep an eye on reset announcements.
detail: Tibo’s latest three original posts · Optional Chrome extension
voice: I also connected Tibo's X updates. A paired Chrome extension reads his latest three original posts and flags possible reset signals and any timing he mentions. It's a heads-up, not a guarantee. Your account's allowance is still the source of truth.
